anchor_experiment: Instrument the experiment ledger and backfill personal baselines by topic, format, and publication age
primary_success_metrics: complete capture of qualified comments, saves, sends, reposts, profile viewers, relevant followers, signups, unique tool uses, and customer conversations
secondary_metrics: impressions and reactions as context only
decision_gate: Do not start winner claims until matched-age baselines exist

anchor_experiment: Replicate the career-navigation mechanism twice with different real decisions
controlled_comparison: identity-gap question versus consequence-first opening; keep static-map format and CTA family stable
artifact: career path map and adjacent-capability matrix
primary_success_metrics: save rate, relevant-follower conversion, qualified career questions/comments
secondary_metrics: profile-viewer rate, sends, shares, median impressions
decision_gate: Keep only if quality metrics beat the matched static-image baseline in at least two replications

controlled_comparison: complete matrix versus worked decision board; matched audience and publication age
artifact: ABC-XYZ treatment board, safety-stock uncertainty check, or equivalent current pain
primary_success_metrics: save rate, qualified planner comments, unique artifact uses
decision_gate: Scale the artifact structure only if intent and role relevance improve, even if reach is below the career-map outlier

anchor_experiment: Run a sourced named-company case pair
controlled_comparison: famous-company curiosity opening versus operating-consequence opening; same before/after visual grammar
primary_success_metrics: qualified practitioner comments, saves, relevant followers
decision_gate: Require two cases; one topical spike is not a reusable mechanism

anchor_experiment: Repackage AI from tool-first to decision-first
controlled_comparison: matched operating pain where tool name appears only after the decision and validation method
primary_audience: planners, procurement practitioners, and transformation leads
artifact: safe sample workflow plus human-validation checklist
primary_success_metrics: unique tool uses, qualified operator comments, saves, customer conversations
decision_gate: Kill or redesign if downstream use and practitioner response do not improve over tool-first history

controlled_comparison: risk-adjusted priority board versus explanatory infographic; same pain and audience
primary_success_metrics: saves, buyer-specific comments, unique uses, customer conversations
decision_gate: Advance only if observed buyer/category-manager response appears in both replications

anchor_experiment: Test authentic authority and CTA restraint
controlled_comparison: source-gated operational failure boundary plus first check versus polished generic explanation; reflective practitioner question versus no CTA
primary_success_metrics: qualified-comment share, saves, sends, customer conversations
decision_gate: Prefer the version with stronger practitioner substance; do not use keyword gates

controlled_comparison: Compare only matched topic/format/age cohorts; separate reach, intent, and business outcomes
artifact: decision memo and updated topic map
primary_success_metrics: replicated qualified outcomes and downstream actions
decision_gate: Scale, revise, or kill each hypothesis; views alone cannot qualify a winner
